articles.summary: Period poverty harms women’s health and productivity. Employers can ease it through better payroll practices and earned wage access so female employees can manage essential costs.
articles.title: Empowerment at Work: Payroll and Period Poverty

articles.summary: A financially stressed workforce is bad for business. Employers can play a significant role in helping staff build financial wellness and in so doing, reduce the impact of financial stress on employees and the business' bottom line. Financial wellness should be an integral part of employee wellbeing programmes.
articles.title: Financial Wellness is key to Employee Wellbeing

articles.summary: Flexible work is only part of the future. Employee well-being and financial stability drive productivity. Floatpays helps employees save, budget, and reduce stress.
articles.title: The future of work
